title: The Traitors India Season 2 Premieres on Prime Video With 21 Celebrity Contestants
excerpt: Karan Johar returns as host for the second season of the BAFTA and Emmy Award-winning reality format, featuring Mallika Sherawat, Rhea Chakraborty, and Krystle D'Souza among the celebrity cast.
body:
• The Traitors India Season 2 premieres on Prime Video on August 13, with new episodes every Thursday
  • Karan Johar returns as host, with 21 celebrity contestants including Mallika Sherawat, Rhea Chakraborty, Krystle D'Souza, Ranveer Brar, and Dalip Tahil
  • Produced by Dharmatic Entertainment in collaboration with All3Media International, the show is an Indian adaptation of the globally successful BAFTA and Emmy Award-winning format
  • Season 1 became a cultural moment in India, with the franchise now adapted in over 40 countries worldwide

A Bigger, Bolder Game of Betrayal

Prime Video has launched the second season of The Traitors, its hit reality franchise in India, on August 13. The Indian adaptation of IDTV's internationally acclaimed reality format brings back filmmaker Karan Johar as host and master orchestrator of a high-stakes game built around trust, betrayal, and psychological strategy.

https://x.com/PrimeVideoIN/status/2087614067842162759

The new season features 21 celebrity contestants drawn from across India's entertainment industry — actors, comedians, digital creators, and public personalities. The confirmed cast includes Mallika Sherawat, Rhea Chakraborty, Krystle D'Souza, celebrity chef Ranveer Brar, and veteran actor Dalip Tahil, among others.

"This season shocked, surprised, appalled and even terrified me. I saw the level of betrayal, I saw the level of attack, I saw the level of manipulation, and I saw the level of strategy that I was not expecting."

— Karan Johar, Host, The Traitors India

How the Game Works

Housed under one roof, the contestants compete in a series of tasks to build a prize fund. Among them, a select group of "traitors" — secretly chosen by Johar — must conceal their identities while systematically eliminating innocent players. The rest of the group must work together to unmask the traitors through confrontational roundtable discussions, strategic alliances, and psychological reads.

At the show's launch event in Mumbai on July 30, Johar described the intensity of the new season, saying there was "an attack and stab in the back" every night. The show, he said, stopped feeling like a game and became an actual battle of betrayal.

Building on Season 1's Breakthrough

The first season of The Traitors India premiered in June 2025 and ran through July 2025. It featured 20 celebrity contestants competing for a prize of Rs 1 crore, with participants including Raj Kundra, Anshula Kapoor, Maheep Kapoor, casting director Mukesh Chhabra, musician Raftaar, and influencer Uorfi Javed.

Nikhil Madhok, Director and Head of Originals at Prime Video India, called the first season "a cultural moment" that exceeded all expectations. "The Traitors has become one of Prime Video India's most defining reality franchises, transforming the genre with its unique blend of intelligent gameplay, psychological strategy, and riveting entertainment," Madhok said.

A Global Format With Indian Flair

The Traitors is produced by Dharmatic Entertainment in collaboration with All3Media International, based on IDTV's BAFTA and Emmy Award-winning format. The franchise has been adapted in over 40 countries, making it one of the world's fastest-growing reality formats.

"Season one of The Traitors broke through the clutter and formulaic reality content, and the audience response proved they were ready for something fresh. With season two, we knew we had to return with a game that was bigger, sharper, and even more unpredictable."

— Karan Johar

Johar noted that returning players came prepared this time. "The Players entered the palace fully aware of the format's twists and traps, armed with strategies, stronger instincts, and a ruthlessness that caught me off guard," he said. "You'll witness friendships unravel, trust give way to paranoia, alliances crumble."

New episodes of The Traitors India Season 2 will stream exclusively on Prime Video every Thursday following the premiere.
